'''Brytan''' is a small village in the northwest of [[Altara]].

Brytan was a small village that only contained a dozen families. During his travels across the nation, [[Perrin Aybara]] went through the village two days after the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]]. Despite the cold of winter, many of his people refused to stay in the buildings due to an infestation of vermin.{{ref/book|10|5}} After his attack on [[Malden]], Perrin camps near Brytan to let [[Jur Grady]] and [[Fager Neald]] rest.{{ref/book|11|26}}
